resolutions.summary: The mechanism narrative is DELETED, not rewritten to a fourth version, per the human's instruction. ADR-032 §b2a now states one thing as the rule -- `span.start <= offset < span.end`, half-open, cells and tables alike -- and says explicitly that no summary of its consequences appears there because three have been written and three have been false. Two facts follow as WHY the comparison must be applied rather than predicted (an emits nothing; spans are tightened to visible characters and empty cells clamped), and then the section stops. What used to be a five-row rule table is now labelled 'Measured instances -- not a taxonomy and not exhaustive', each row a shape the rule was wrongly generalized from, with separate CELL and TABLE columns so no row can say a bare 'outside' again.
resolutions.reproduction: Confirmed exactly. `/s/Darren W. Woods` -> image offset 12, cell (9, 27): inside its own cell, and the cell's text begins at 9, not at the mark. Both 'only when that span's own visible text begins exactly at the mark' and 'The only shape that is' are false on it.

Rewriting the pin to round 3's wording (`moff == mcell[0]`) -> AssertionError ([4, 22], 7); to round 2's wording (`moff == mcell[1]`) -> AssertionError ([4, 22], 7). resolutions.structural_change_requested_by_the_revie: The round-3 artifact's structural_observation was that each _demo was built from the example that produced the wording, so it confirmed the sentence instead of testing it. What changed: _demo no longer asserts any rule. It applies the one comparison and records the measured answer per shape, and the two shapes that falsified previous wordings are among them. There is no sentence left in the ADR for a future demo to confirm.

resolutions.summary: 'The corpus is entirely the fourth case' is deleted. §b2a now carries a two-row split table of what actually happens, and the instance table gains the wholly-text-empty-table outcome the enumeration omitted.
resolutions.reproduction: Confirmed, and independently re-derived per image rather than taken from the finding. A tag-depth scan over the four fixtures with in-table images classifies all 10: leading-row clamp (a record starts exactly +2 after the image) for ba-2003 50321, bac-2006 391006 x2 and xom-2021 232186 x3 = 6 of 10; NO table record enclosing or following the image at all for cvx-2015 133962 / 137973 / 145599 / 166482 = 4 of 10. Zero fall into any other outcome. Nearest records to 133962 are (127392, 128503) and (145616, 145697), matching the finding.
resolutions.the_split_as_published: 6 of 10 leading-row clamp (ba-2003 1, bac-2006 2, xom-2021 3), a record exists starting 2 characters after the image; 4 of 10 cvx-2015, whose enclosing <table> has no visible text anywhere in it and is dropped entirely by ADR-029 §b1, so no span exists for the comparison to be applied to. '0 of 53 offsets inside any recorded span' is unchanged and still true -- what was wrong was the single reason given for it.
